Name: Star Crops and Galaxy Trees - Vanilla Tweaks Edition
Author: MissAnaira
Description:
This Content Patcher mod is a re-texture for my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32584]Star Crops[/url] mod! These textures are styled from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] mod.
[size=1]Thank you Tai for allowing me to retexture this beautiful pack for my mod![/size]

There are two [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] configurations for each of the Vanilla Tweaks (VT) versions 1.0 and 2.0, to be compatible with whichever VT version you have downloaded. Enjoy!

Manifest.Description: Vanilla Tweaks-styled textures for MissAnaira's Star Crops.
